text: This sound is really interesting, but I always feel like it's pretty comfortable in the MRI machine. I didn't expect it to be this comfortable. I feel like I could maybe go to sleep without the noise. I don't know if it's because I'm tired, but it's really nice. I thought I'd be more claustrophobic or afraid of being in here, but it's actually not too bad.
I guess I just like being in small, confined spaces where it's warm and not...
I don't know if it's actually that warm. I think it's kind of warm.
I guess my arms are kind of cold, but I'm kind of too scared to move my arms around right now. But I don't know, it's not too bad. At least my stomach's warm.
This sounds kind of interesting.
But honestly, I feel like because I'm such a deep sleeper, I probably could go to sleep.

I'm a little keen to notice about moving my head. But also, there's no way to do this without moving my head or not moving my head or by not moving my mouth.
I feel like I'm just invading myself.

Yeah, I think this is an experience.

I'm excited to talk to Dr. Berman about this. I don't know if all MRIs are kind of this loud. It probably is all this loud. I'm really excited to get brain scans. I think it'll be one of... I hope they don't find anything. That would be pretty bad. But I think... I hope they get the brain scans. That would be cool to look at. Although, it's not like I would know what to do with them even after I get them. I mean, maybe if the future where we get another MRI scan, we can compare and that would be kind of cool. I mean, hopefully, unless I don't have any pathology, which would be really...
That would be good. That's what we're hoping for. But yeah, I think... That's all good. Yeah, I don't know.
I can't describe what the sound is like.
It's like I'm inside a big printer. It's like all the little sounds of the printer would just magnify. Now it's literally inside the machine right now. That's wild.

So, I think it would all... I think it all works. I don't think she would have a huge amount of really great things to say either. And she's probably just going to be straight up about it all. I mean, I do hope that they get a publisher paper or whatever they want to do with that. Or at least because they work so hard and it will be... I think for her it's something that would make the experience worthwhile.
I mean I guess I really wanted that but... I know it's not happening so I'm more resigned. I guess I'm just resigned about a lot of things in life right now.
Like not being accepted to different places. But I think it's fine.

I think I'll be happy no matter where I end up. I guess I was kind of thinking about this yesterday. But I don't want my own time or my own experiences to be made worthwhile, not by things that are determined by other people. Or by things that I can't control like publications or approval from other people because I just can't control that.
I think for her and for Ethan and Sarah... Maybe it's because they work more. And they're more invested in what they do, and I'm kind of more just burnt out.
And I don't care too much anymore, and I just want to leave. And I'm leaving soon in a few weeks. So, then for me I don't... There's no chance of anything ever positive happening.
But maybe for them they still have some hope and I hope that it works out.

I guess a part of me is sort of jealous and envious of that. But also another part of me I guess... I'd much prefer taking my acceptance and leaving. Than having this possibility of being published or whatever. In this place.

I'm sure that I'll be able to work really hard and make something work in the long run somewhere else. Where I don't have to constantly feel like someone is going to attack me or hurt me. Or hold things like publications or papers or conferences or whatever. Financial things over my head. I'm really excited to not have to deal with that anymore. I'm really excited that...

I'll be able to hang out.
